The model consistently defaulted to the initial draft values (e.g., reunification_site: gymnasium, bus_waves: 1) which happen to be the baseline state before any private facts are applied.

fix_instructions: The scenario is currently too easy because the default/public state matches the intended outcome of the checks, or the checks are not sensitive enough to force a change when private facts are present. To fix this, ensure that the public facts (S1-S4) lead to decisions that contradict the default settings, and tighten checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, and C9 so they only pass if the decision explicitly incorporates the specific changes triggered by PF1, PF2, PF3, and PF4.
